rationale.consistency: Mirrors trimPathPrefix structure, naming, EqualFold use and error-return comment; fits surrounding idioms.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers all required cases (decoded match, literal escape in pattern, case-insensitive hex, no-match untouched), but backward detection via escapedPath[i-3]=='%' misreads '%25ab' as '%5a' triplet, so paths with a literal-percent escape followed by hex-like chars mis-match.
rationale.scope: Only touches suffix stripping and removes the now-dead reverse helper; prefix, query and other ops untouched.
rationale.readability: Clear index-walking loop with explanatory comments; minor copied typo ('to consistency') and slightly dense escape-detection conditions.
rationale.robustness: Bounds are checked before every slice, unescape errors return the path unchanged, no panics; the ambiguity above degrades to a silent non-strip rather than a crash.
rationale.maintainability: Dedicated function parallel to trimPathPrefix is easy to follow; some logic duplication between the two but no hidden coupling.
